title: Long code weighted experiment
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$, and let a sign tester have a finite seed set and a probability law on it. The associated weighted constraint experiment has as outcomes the long code experiment samples, distributed according to the experiment law; the predicate selected by an outcome is its tester seed, and its ordered scope is the tuple of long code experiment variables at the check's input positions.
